user_story: As a user, I want to be able to see notification messages when I perform specific actions on the application so that I can be informed about the status of my actions. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When the user clicks on the link 'Click here', they should be redirected to the notification messages page and see the element with id 'flash-messages'. 2. The user should still see the element with id 'content' after interaction, confirming the page is loaded correctly.
